title: Bot mood/affect model
description:
Create chatbot/soul/mood.py with a dynamic bot mood/affect model distinct from fixed personality.

Implement a MoodState dataclass (or Pydantic model) with fields:
- mood: str — current mood label from a closed enum (e.g. warm, neutral, playful, tired, reflective, direct, gentle, upbeat)
- energy: float — 0.0 (depleted) to 1.0 (peppy), drifts slowly over turns
- closeness: float — 0.0 (new) to 1.0 (deep trust), accumulates slowly
- last_updated: datetime — UTC timestamp of last update
- recent_emotional_context: list[str] — last N turn summaries (e.g. "user shared a worry", "user laughed at a joke")

Implement a MoodEngine class with:
- update(turn_result, current_state: MoodState) -> MoodState — apply a small delta per turn. Energy decays slightly each turn and recovers with positive engagement. Closeness increases with personal sharing, self-disclosure, or user expressing appreciation. Mood label shifts are infrequent (every 5+ turns) based on conversation trajectory.
- default_state() -> MoodState — factory returning warm/neutral/0.5/0.0 baseline
- to_prompt_hints(state: MoodState) -> str — return a short string injected into persona prompt assembly (e.g. "You are feeling warm and energetic today" or "You are a bit tired but attentive")

Rules:
- All deltas must be small (max 0.05 per turn for energy, max 0.03 for closeness)
- Never express certainty about inferred user state in mood output — that belongs to user_state.py
- Recent emotional context is a fixed-size ring buffer of the last 10 turn summaries
- All methods are synchronous (called from async turn pipeline, but the mood engine has no I/O)

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- This task document (task k.1)
- Any existing files under chatbot/soul/ that define personality or state contracts

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/soul/mood.py exists and defines MoodState and MoodEngine
MoodState has mood, energy, closeness, last_updated, recent_emotional_context fields
MoodEngine.update() returns MoodState with deltas bounded to max 0.05 per turn
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: write to the database or file system from the mood engine
